## Wolverine Worldwide’s Saucony Named Brand of the Year by Footwear News


November 16, 2026


*Top Industry Honor Recognizes Brand’s Product Innovation and Growth*


ROCKFORD, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Wolverine World Wide, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwolverineworldwide.com%2F&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=Wolverine+World+Wide%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=1b9eb21ed750293ad9669f12199d2a04) . (NYSE: WWW) today announced that its[Saucony](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.saucony.com%2Fen%2Fhome&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=Saucony&index=2&md5=8bd06a7c9f567f3fc5a7ccecd13b996d) brand has been named 2026[Brand of the Year](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwwd.com%2Ffootwear-news%2Fshoe-industry-news%2Ffootwear-news-fnaa-2026-winners-1239400682%2F&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=Brand+of+the+Year&index=3&md5=5b5d91296b55302f123f1e4ac682151c) by *Footwear News* and will be recognized at the Footwear News Achievement Awards (FNAA) on Wednesday, December 2, in New York City.


The honor recognizes Saucony’s continued focus on creating innovative products, building authentic consumer connections and bringing its distinctive brand story to life around the world.


"Being named Brand of the Year is an incredible recognition of Saucony and the team behind it," said Chris Hufnagel, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wolverine Worldwide. "Saucony has a clear understanding of who it is, the consumers it serves and what makes the brand special. This recognition reflects the creativity, discipline and passion of the global Saucony team and is another powerful example of what great brand building looks like across Wolverine Worldwide."


Saucony’s selection follows Wolverine Worldwide being named *Footwear News* ’ 2025 Company of the Year, when the publication recognized the transformation of the Company and strength of its portfolio. This recognition culminates an award-winning year for Wolverine Worldwide and its portfolio of brands. In 2026, the Company was recognized by:


- *Fortune,* as one of[America’s Best Large Workplaces for Retail](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffortune.com%2Franking%2Fbest-workplaces-retail%2F&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=America%26%238217%3Bs+Best+Large+Workplaces+for+Retail&index=4&md5=92c231203ef57c86fb2b06d5b1e3ceb1)
- *Fortune,* as one of[America’s Best Large Workplaces for Women](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffortune.com%2Franking%2Fbest-workplaces-for-women%2F&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=America%26%238217%3Bs+Best+Large+Workplaces+for+Women&index=5&md5=4c875858128eb1f9f4db1dc33c7e3ec5)
- *Newsweek,* as one of the[World’s Most Trustworthy Companies](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frankings.newsweek.com%2Fworlds-most-trustworthy-companies-2026%2Ftextiles-clothing-luxury-goods&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=World%26%238217%3Bs+Most+Trustworthy+Companies&index=6&md5=0cd62995c9a6a6bbb4171e323191c260)
- *Forbes* , as one of[America’s Best Midsize Employers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.forbes.com%2Flists%2Fbest-midsize-employers%2F&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=America%26%238217%3Bs+Best+Midsize+Employers&index=7&md5=d164078fcf29054b106534b500a401c1)
- *Great Place to Work* , as a[Great Place to Work-Certified™ Company](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fcertified-company%2F1432604&esheet=54641958&newsitemid=20261116090310&lan=en-US&anchor=Great+Place+to+Work-Certified%26%238482%3B+Company&index=8&md5=7d0e4236e052d4101bb06aba13700862)


Together, these honors underscore the impact of Wolverine Worldwide’s focus on building brands through compelling products, distinctive storytelling and strong consumer connections, supported by a culture that values inclusion and empowers its people.


"During a time of immense change and challenge in the athletic industry, Saucony drove one of the most impressive performances with innovative product and smart storytelling,” said Michael Atmore, Editorial Director, FN; Editor-in-Chief, WWD; Chief Brand Officer, Fairchild Media Group. “In 2026, the brand made notable strides with lifestyle footwear that was both on-trend and faithful to its legacy while delivering the cutting-edge performance shoes that today’s consumers demand.”


For four decades the FNAAs – often called the “Shoe Oscars” – have celebrated the footwear industry’s major style stars, best brands and brand stories, philanthropists, emerging talents, and industry veterans.
